title: The Grumble-Mountain
description: Justin's original gentle giant: a mountain that is alive, and grumbles when quarries take too much.

title: The Ink-Kraken
description: Justin's original sea-beast: a kraken of living ink that writes warnings on the hulls of ships.

title: The Clockwork Dragon
description: Justin's original machine-dragon: a dragon of brass gears that eats broken clocks and keeps perfect time.

title: The Library Leviathan
description: Justin's original deep-keeper: a leviathan that guards the drowned libraries of the world.

title: The Storm-Maw
description: Justin's original sky-beast: a living storm with teeth of lightning that hunts drought.

title: The Mirror-Wolf
description: Justin's original pack-hunter: a wolf whose coat shows the viewer their own true face.

title: The Ironwood Ent
description: Justin's original tree-giant: an ent of ironwood, slow as geology and strong as a dam.

title: The Paper Phoenix
description: Justin's original rebirth-bird: a phoenix of written pages that is reborn whenever its story is retold.
